heroTitle:

intro: Study why physician markets differ from simple competitive markets, how physician-induced demand can arise, how income and substitution effects interact, and why payment incentives and practice styles matter.
attribution: Independent student-written study guide based on Daniele Fabbri’s Fundamentals in Health Economics, Session 5: Physician Agency, University of Bologna. Official slides and assigned readings are not reproduced. Always check Virtuale for the official materials.
